Third-party notices
===================

LiquidGlass 1.0.3
-----------------
Author / upstream: ybouane — https://github.com/ybouane/liquidglass
Package: @ybouane/liquidglass@1.0.3
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ybouane/liquidglass@1.0.3/dist/index.js
License: MIT, as declared in the upstream package.json.
The upstream npm package and repository do not contain a separate LICENSE file.
liquidglass.js is the pinned browser bundle with one local integration patch:
linked stylesheet font URLs are resolved against the stylesheet URL using
../liquid-glass-fonts.mjs, rather than against the current Razor page URL.
The rendering implementation is otherwise unchanged.

The browser bundle includes html-to-image, whose license follows.

html-to-image
-------------
Upstream: https://github.com/bubkoo/html-to-image
